args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.head: fix/bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
args.body:
The nightly build fails because tests/test_money.py expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) but src/money.py used ROUND_HALF_UP.

This change updates round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN so that:
- round_money(Decimal("2.675")) == Decimal("2.68")
- round_money(Decimal("2.665")) == Decimal("2.66")

CI has passed on this branch.
